searchText: It doesn't make sense to me to have two constants, the number is going to be the same because security is about how many samples you get, not about how "wide" the samples are You can think of `SAMPLES_PER_SLOT` as a security parameter without units I guess And whatever sampling you choose to do needs to get `SAMPLES_PER_SLOT` random/pseudo-random samples, for whatever sample definition you use, as long as it's some verifiable vertical slice of the extended matrix As for custody sampling specifically, this paragraph clarifies that we are sampling custody groups: ``` At each slot, a node advertising custody_group_count downloads a minimum of sampling_size = max(SAMPLES_PER_SLOT, custody_group_count) custody groups, selected by groups = get_custody_groups(node_id, sampling_size) ``` Would you want more clarifications here? I've just suggested. No support is ok. Some support is ok 😀 What do you mean by support? 🙂 Anyway, happy to add clarifications if needed, just wanted to explain the current state more I mean if noone else wants this I'm pretty fine to keep it as is We have enough info around to clarify it, like the method you mentioned I just used to have long names for everything in Java 😂

excerpts.author: fradamt
excerpts.content: And whatever sampling you  choose to do needs to get `SAMPLES_PER_SLOT` random/pseudo-random samples, for whatever sample definition you use, as long as it's some verifiable vertical slice of the extended matrix

excerpts.author: fradamt
excerpts.content:
As for custody sampling specifically, this paragraph clarifies that we are sampling custody groups:

```
At each slot, a node advertising custody_group_count downloads a minimum of sampling_size = max(SAMPLES_PER_SLOT, custody_group_count) custody groups, selected by groups = get_custody_groups(node_id, sampling_size)
```

Would you want more clarifications here?
